decisions.reason: The medical examination light builds on existing competences and costs little to keep listed, and with no recent results showing its value is lost, keeping the option open is still worthwhile.
The explosion-proof line serves core industrial customers, carries sunk certification investments and has a durable niche, so it deserves continued commitment.
The relaunched designer task light builds on a proven popular product and costs little to maintain, though its age raises some risk of replacement by a newer LED generation.
The pendant office luminaire is close to the core office lighting range and was launched recently, so its value is still uncertain and keeping it costs little.
The premium pendant line with several models fits the established offer and needs more time on the market to show its value, so the option should stay open.
